info.title: MetaReader API
info.summary: Build computational-reproducibility packages for scholarly papers.
info.description:
The HTTP API. Run with ``mr serve``; interactive docs at /docs (Swagger UI) and /redoc.

Conventions: versioned under /v1; JSON bodies; errors are RFC 9457 problem details; POST creates (201 +
Location), PUT replaces explicitly, PATCH is a JSON merge patch, DELETE returns 204; every package-scoped
response carries the package's ETag, and unsafe requests may send If-Match (412 on mismatch).

put.summary: Create or replace the master script
put.description: Resolves the plan (load steps for used data inputs → enabled actions → results step), writes `analysis_plan.json`, `results_schema.json`, the template's files and README.md. Returns 201 the first time, 200 when replacing. Files changed since they were generated are only overwritten with `force`.

422.description: `nothing_to_script`: At least one enabled target and one enabled action are needed

409.description: `script_modified`: Generated files were changed since; pass force to overwrite

schema.title: Response Agent Profiles V1 Agent Profiles Get

422.description: `request_invalid`: The request body or parameters don't match the API schema

post.description: `type: codegen` runs the configured coding agent in the package folder to implement the master script's `TODO(LLM):` markers. `type: run` runs the master script with the template's command (output and errors as `log` events), then checks `outputs/results.json`. The package is committed to git before and after. Returns 202 at once; follow the job at its `Location`, its progress at `…/events`.

get.summary: Compare reproduced results with the targets
get.description: Reads `outputs/results.json` and compares it with the targets of `results_schema.json` (the ones the code was written against). Numbers are rounded to the reported decimals (`rounding=reported`) or to a fixed number; a deviation up to `threshold` % counts as within tolerance; tables are compared cell by cell.

("Every TODO(LLM) block must be implemented…") is not counted: only the marker followed by a colon is.

url.title: Url
url.description: download URL (secrets such as API keys removed)

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.description: candidate id it was chosen as

label.title: Label
label.description: where the candidate came from, e.g. "OpenAlex best OA location"

HTTPBearer.description: Required only if the service config sets a token.

tags.name: service
tags.description: Health, configured LLM profiles, script templates, problem types.

tags.name: packages
tags.description: Create, list and validate packages. A package is a folder with a Frictionless `datapackage.json`.

tags.name: metadata
tags.description: OpenAlex metadata of the package's work.

tags.name: fulltexts
tags.description: Full-text files (PDF, TEI, JATS, Docling JSON), accepted after an integrity check.

tags.name: extractions
tags.description: Full texts in the common document schema: parsed, or reconciled by an LLM.

tags.name: inputs
tags.description: Input files of the reproduction (data / code / other).

tags.name: targets
tags.description: Results to reproduce: added by hand or extracted by an LLM, with non-destructive edits.

tags.name: actions
tags.description: Analysis steps described in the paper (the former analysis plan).

tags.name: script
tags.description: Master-script templates rendered from targets and actions.

tags.name: jobs
tags.description: Long-running work (coding agent, pipeline run) followed asynchronously, with live progress events.

tags.name: comparison
tags.description: Reproduced results compared with the targets.

tags.name: report
tags.description: The reproduction report and the ZIP of the package.
